POST /auth/refresh removed the request body
POST /auth/refresh removed the success response with the status `201`
PUT /resolutions/{resolution_id}/close the `total_voting_power` request property type/format changed from `number`/`double` to `string`/``
POST /resolutions/{resolution_id}/vote the `voting_power` request property type/format changed from `number`/`double` to `string`/``
POST /buildings added the new required request property `acp_id`
